article_title: Why do we love watching hoarder videos online so much?

tasks.prompt: What main explanation does the article give for the popularity of online hoarder-cleaning videos?
options: They combine curiosity and the satisfaction of transformation, while algorithms amplify attention-grabbing content
They teach viewers how to buy more household objects
They are watched mainly by professional builders seeking technical advice
They have replaced all other forms of television entertainment
tasks.correct_answer: They combine curiosity and the satisfaction of transformation, while algorithms amplify attention-grabbing content
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה משלבת הסברים פסיכולוגיים — סקרנות וסיפוק מן השינוי — עם תפקיד האלגוריתמים בהפצת תוכן מושך תשומת לב.

tasks.prompt: What kinds of scenes can Victoria Gordon encounter when she enters a client’s home?
options: Empty rooms prepared for sale
Only neatly labelled storage boxes
Huge clothing piles, unwashed dishes and badly blocked toilets
Museum displays of valuable antiques
tasks.correct_answer: Huge clothing piles, unwashed dishes and badly blocked toilets
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפתיחה מתארת ערימות בגדים, כלים לא שטופים ושירותים סתומים מאוד.

tasks.prompt: What does “mundane” mean when the article discusses cleaning?
options: Dangerous and illegal
Ordinary and everyday
Scientifically unproven
Expensive and luxurious
tasks.explanation_hebrew: mundane פירושו שגרתי או יומיומי; הסרטונים הופכים פעולה רגילה לבידור.

tasks.prompt: What signal do social-media algorithms use when recommending more of these videos?
options: How long a user keeps watching
Whether the room belongs to a celebrity
The price of the cleaning products
How many rooms the viewer owns
tasks.correct_answer: How long a user keeps watching
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי ההסבר בכתבה, האלגוריתם לומד מזמן הצפייה; הוא יודע שהמשתמש לא גלל הלאה.

tasks.prompt: How can the recommendation system make a viewer’s feed more extreme?
options: It removes every cleaning video after one view
It asks viewers to clean their own homes before continuing
It limits recommendations to gentle organisation tips
It may serve worse rooms and crime scenes because they hold attention
tasks.correct_answer: It may serve worse rooms and crime scenes because they hold attention
tasks.explanation_hebrew: כאשר זמן צפייה נחשב למדד איכות, המערכת עלולה להציע חדרים ומראות קיצוניים יותר שמחזיקים את תשומת הלב.

tasks.prompt: In the article’s ethical discussion, what does “stigma” refer to?
options: A specialist cleaning tool
A social mark of shame attached to hoarding
A metric measuring video length
A method for sorting possessions
tasks.correct_answer: A social mark of shame attached to hoarding
tasks.explanation_hebrew: stigma היא סטיגמה חברתית או אות קלון; הכתבה מזהירה מפני שיפוט אנשים המתמודדים עם אגירה.

tasks.prompt: Give two reasons viewers may find the transformation in these videos satisfying or reassuring.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני מנגנונים שמופיעים בכתבה ולקשור אותם לחוויית הצפייה.
expected_points: Viewers see visible order emerge from chaos
A clear before-and-after result gives closure
The cleaning creates a sense of control
The videos satisfy curiosity about other people’s homes
A difficult transformation can make an ordinary task feel dramatic

tasks.prompt: Why can long watch time be a misleading measure of video quality?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את ההבדל בין תשומת לב לבין ערך או איכות, ואת תפקיד האלגוריתם.
expected_points: A user may keep watching from shock, disgust or morbid curiosity
The algorithm sees that the user did not scroll away but cannot know why
Attention does not prove that content is helpful or ethical
Using watch time can encourage increasingly extreme recommendations

tasks.prompt: Summarise how psychology, cleaning creators and platform algorithms together explain the appeal of hoarder videos.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לשלב שלושה רבדים: תוכן הניקיון, תגובת הצופה ומנגנון ההמלצות.
expected_points: Creators such as Victoria Gordon show dramatic, difficult clean-ups
Viewers are curious about unfamiliar private spaces
The movement from chaos to order can feel satisfying and reassuring
Algorithms treat sustained attention as engagement or quality
Platforms then recommend more and sometimes more extreme examples
The result turns a mundane task into a viral phenomenon

tasks.prompt: Suggest two ways creators or platforms could present hoarder clean-ups responsibly without losing their educational value.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציע שני צעדים מעשיים ולהסביר כיצד הם מפחיתים שיפוטיות או ניצול תוך שמירה על ערך לצופה.
expected_points: Protect clients’ privacy and obtain meaningful consent
Use respectful language and avoid humiliating close-ups
Explain that hoarding is a complex condition rather than laziness
Include information about professional or mental-health support
Avoid thumbnails designed only to provoke disgust
Platforms should not amplify increasingly extreme scenes solely because of watch time
